info.title: Rollo API
info.description: Rollo backend: accounts, trips, shared rolls and the reveal at the end.

linkChallenge.description: base64url (no padding) of SHA-256 of a random verifier the app keeps on the phone (PKCE-style, 43 chars). Only with it does the email include a magic link, and the link only works with that verifier (`/auth/email/verify-link`). Without it (old app builds) the email carries only the code.

token.description: Session token (Bearer). Valid for 365 days; store it on the phone

isNew.description: true while the profile is incomplete (no name or no username): show the profile step

name.description: null until the profile is completed

username.description: Unique handle, lowercase, without the @ (the app shows it as @username); null until chosen

avatarUrl.description: Path (the app prefixes the API base URL), e.g. /avatars/<userId>/<version>.jpg; null if none

bio.description: Profile description (up to 3 lines); null if none

badge.description: Profile badge assigned by hand (founder = Founder, first_edition = First Edition); null if none

ProfileVisibility.description: Who can see your bio and featured photos: your friends only, or anyone signed in. Name, username and avatar are always visible

code.description: 6-character code from the email (letters and digits, no 0/O/1/I/L). Case-insensitive; spaces and dashes are ignored

token.description: Token from the magic link in the email (the `t` parameter of its fragment)

verifier.description: The verifier whose SHA-256 was sent as `linkChallenge` to `/auth/email/start` (43–128 chars of `A-Z a-z 0-9 - . _ ~`). Without the right one the link fails like a wrong token.

requests.description: Pending requests to you, most recent first

bio.description: Profile description (up to 3 lines); null if none

username.description: Optional leading @, trimmed and lowercased. a-z 0-9 . _ (3 to 30), no leading/trailing dot, no ".."

bio.description: Profile description, up to 150 characters and 3 lines after trimming. An empty string clears it

sizeBytes.description: Exact byte size of the JPEG (max 2 MB); the upload URL is signed for exactly this Content-Length

coverThumbhash.description: ThumbHash of the most recently taken uploaded photo or video of the rollo (null if none); the app derives the rollo's color from it

addedToTrip.description: Someone adds you to a rollo

tripStarted.description: A rollo you are in starts

tripRevealed.description: A rollo you are in is revealed

photoFeatured.description: Someone features a photo of yours on their profile

photoLiked.description: Someone likes a photo of yours

photoCommented.description: Someone comments on a photo of yours, or on one you commented on

friendRequest.description: Someone sends you a friend request

allowFeaturing.description: Others may feature any of your photos on their profile (on by default)

addedToTrip.description: Someone adds you to a rollo

tripStarted.description: A rollo you are in starts

tripRevealed.description: A rollo you are in is revealed

photoFeatured.description: Someone features a photo of yours on their profile

photoLiked.description: Someone likes a photo of yours

photoCommented.description: Someone comments on a photo of yours, or on one you commented on

friendRequest.description: Someone sends you a friend request

allowFeaturing.description: Others may feature any of your photos on their profile (on by default)

available.description: true if nobody else has it (also true if it is yours)

username.description: The normalized username that was checked

status.description: sent: the request is pending (or was rejected, which the sender never sees); friends: you are friends now (they had asked you too, or you already were)

isFriend.description: Whether you and this user are friends (false for yourself)

reportedByMe.description: Whether you reported this user (their profile, not a photo)

canSee.description: Whether you can see the featured photos and the full friend list: it is you, a friend, or the profile is public, and neither of you blocked the other

friendCount.description: How many friends this user has (always public)

mutualCount.description: How many of your friends are also this user's friends (0 for yourself)

friendRequest.description: Pending friend request between you and this user: sent (you sent one, also after they rejected it: they never tell), received (they sent you one you have not answered), none (also for friends, yourself and blocks)

bio.description: Profile description; null if none. Always public, whatever canSee says

badge.description: Profile badge assigned by hand (founder = Founder, first_edition = First Edition); null if none

scope.description: all: every friend of this user (canSee); mutual: only the friends you have in common

expiresAt.description: The link stops working at this instant (1 hour after it was generated)

code.description: Friend code typed or taken from a link that is still valid

commonTrips.description: Rollos both of you are active members of, most recent start first

commentId.description: Comment to report (on a photo of a rollo you are in)

claimToken.description: Permission to redeem this link while signed in. Valid for 24 hours

expiresAt.description: The claim token stops working at this instant

code.description: Case-insensitive; spaces and dashes are ignored

dailyVideoLimit.description: Legacy: new rollos have no videos (0)

featuringDisabled.description: Private rollo: nobody can feature its photos on a profile, not even their author

photoLimitMode.description: daily: dailyPhotoLimit per person per local day; total: totalPhotoLimit per person for the whole rollo

totalPhotoLimit.description: Photos per person in the whole rollo; null in daily mode

momentMode.description: Daily moment: off, a photo, or a photo plus a selfie

momentWindowStart.description: Moment window start, minutes from midnight in the rollo's time zone

momentWindowEnd.description: Moment window end, minutes from midnight in the rollo's time zone

id.description: Membership id (the one used by DELETE members and FeedItem.author)

allowFeaturing.description: Only on `me`: others may feature your photos of this rollo on their profile

timezone.description: IANA time zone of the destination

endsAt.description: Trip end; must be after startsAt

revealAt.description: When the roll is revealed; must be >= endsAt

dailyVideoLimit.description: Legacy: rollos have no videos, omit it

featuringDisabled.description: Private rollo: nobody can feature its photos on a profile, not even their author

totalPhotoLimit.description: Photos per person in the whole rollo; required when photoLimitMode is total, ignored otherwise

momentMode.description: Daily moment: off, a photo, or a photo plus a selfie. Cannot be changed after creating the rollo

momentWindowStart.description: Start of the daily moment window, in minutes from midnight in the rollo's time zone (default 540 = 9:00)

momentWindowEnd.description: End of the daily moment window, in minutes from midnight; at least 30 after the start (default 1380 = 23:00)

photosLeft.description: Photos left today (daily mode) or in the whole rollo (total mode); 0 outside the rollo's dates

endsAt.description: Trip end; must be after startsAt and <= the resulting revealAt

featuringDisabled.description: Private rollo. Turning it on removes every photo of the rollo from every profile; turning it off restores nothing

totalPhotoLimit.description: Only for rollos in total mode

status.description: added: now a member (also if they had left); already_member; unavailable: not your friend, removed by the admin (unless the caller is the admin), or unknown

friendIds.description: User ids of your friends (1 to 50)

allowFeaturing.description: Others may feature your photos of this rollo. Turning it off removes them from other profiles; turning it on restores nothing

original.description: PUT of the original file; send exactly `sizeBytes` bytes as Content-Length

thumb.description: PUT of the JPEG thumbnail (~800px); send exactly `thumbSizeBytes` bytes as Content-Length

id.description: UUID generated on the phone; retrying with the same id is safe

takenAt.description: Phone time when the shot was taken

thumbhash.description: ThumbHash (https://evanw.github.io/thumbhash/) in standard base64, generated on the phone from the thumbnail. If a retry brings a different value, the first one is kept.

sizeBytes.description: Exact byte size of the original file; the upload URL is signed for exactly this Content-Length

thumbSizeBytes.description: Exact byte size of the thumbnail JPEG; the upload URL is signed for exactly this Content-Length

thumbhash.description: ThumbHash in base64. Always returned, also before the reveal, on purpose: it only encodes blurry colors (~25 bytes), the photo cannot be reconstructed from it.

userId.description: The author's user id (to open their profile)

author.description: `id` is the author's membership id; `userId` their user id

files.description: Download paths; only after the reveal

featuredByMe.description: Only after the reveal: you featured it on your profile

featureBlocked.description: Only after the reveal: the author does not let others feature it (they still can)

canFeature.description: Only after the reveal: whether you can feature it on your profile now (false if its rollo is private, or if its author, their rollo membership or their account does not let others; its author can unless the rollo is private)

likeCount.description: Only after the reveal: how many people like it (one counter, also likes from profiles that feature it). Always 0 for videos

likedByMe.description: Only after the reveal: you like it

commentCount.description: Only after the reveal: how many comments you see on it (not the deleted ones, nor those of blocked users or ones you reported). Always 0 for videos

author.description: Who took it; null when it is the profile owner

likeCount.description: How many people like it (the same counter as in its rollo)

FeaturedPhoto.description: A photo on someone's profile. Never includes the rollo, the caption or the exact location

Zone.description: null if the photo has no GPS

total.description: How many liked photos you can see today, across all pages

author.description: Who took it (for the badge on the thumbnail)

userId.description: Owner of the profile where it is featured

LikedPhotoSource.description: Where you can open the photo today. `trip`: you are an active member of its revealed rollo. `featured`: you see it on that profile (the rollo is never revealed). If both work, it is `trip`.

canDelete.description: You wrote it, or the photo is yours

post.summary: Request a login code by email
post.description: Sends a 6-character code (letters and digits, no 0/O/1/I/L; valid 5 minutes, 5 attempts) and, only when `linkChallenge` is sent, a magic link for the same attempt (`<LOGIN_LINK_URL>#t=<token>&e=<email>`, see `/auth/email/verify-link`), bound to that challenge. Using either one consumes both. A new request invalidates the previous codes. Rate limited per email and per IP, and capped globally per day (429). Works for new and existing users alike.

429.description: Daily limit or rate limit reached

post.summary: Exchange the emailed code for a session token
post.description: Creates the user on the first successful verification. `isNew` is true while the user has no name. The code is case-insensitive and spaces or dashes are ignored; a malformed code is answered like a wrong one.

post.summary: Exchange the emailed magic-link token for a session token
post.description: Same result as `/auth/email/verify`, with the token from the link's fragment instead of the code. Needs the `verifier` whose SHA-256 was sent as `linkChallenge` to `/auth/email/start`: the link only signs in the phone that asked for it. Shares the code's expiry, attempts and single use: a wrong or missing token or verifier uses up an attempt, and after the link or the code is used neither works again. Attempts started without a challenge have no link, so this always fails for them. Every failure answers the same 400. Only POST: the token is never accepted in a URL.

get.description: Pending ones only (the ones you rejected are gone), most recent first.

post.description: Makes you friends and notifies whoever sent it (`newFriend`). 404 if there is no pending request from that user.
Silent: the sender is not notified and keeps seeing it as sent. Also 204 if there was none.

patch.description: Send any of name, username, bio and profileVisibility; fields left out are not changed. The name is shown in every rollo you are part of and does not have to be unique. The username must be unique (case-insensitive); setting your own current one is a no-op. 409 if someone else has it. The bio is trimmed, an empty one clears it (null), and it allows up to 150 characters and 3 lines (400 otherwise). profileVisibility is "friends" (default) or "public"; any other value is a 400.

delete.description: Permanently deletes the account. In every rollo you belong to (also those you were removed from), your photos and videos are deleted (database rows and files, even after the reveal) and your membership is removed. If you were the admin, the oldest remaining active member becomes admin. If no active members remain, the whole rollo is deleted with all its files. Your reports and blocks (made and received), push tokens, settings and likes (yours, and the ones on your photos) are deleted too. Your friendships, friend links and claims, avatar, sessions and pending login codes are deleted too (your friends keep their rollos). The same email can sign up again later as a brand-new user.

post.summary: Get a URL to upload your avatar
post.description: Send the exact byte size of the JPEG (`sizeBytes`, max 2 MB; 400 otherwise). Returns a URL signed for exactly that Content-Length to PUT the JPEG straight to R2. Then call POST /me/avatar/complete. 503 when the storage limit is reached. A previous upload that was never completed is discarded. Each call generates a new random file name, so the avatar URL changes when you replace it.

429.description: Daily limit or rate limit reached

503.description: Storage limit reached; new uploads are paused

post.description: Checks that the file is in R2, is a JPEG (verified by its magic bytes) and is at most 2 MB, makes it your avatar and deletes the previous one. Otherwise the upload is discarded and the response is a 400.

429.description: Daily limit or rate limit reached

get.description: Rollos you are an active member of, most recent start first.

put.description: Registers an Expo push token (ExponentPushToken[...] or ExpoPushToken[...], URL-encoded in the path) for your account. Idempotent: calling it again only refreshes when it was last seen. A token belongs to one account at a time: if another account had it (same phone, another account), it moves to yours. 400 if it is not an Expo push token.

delete.description: Stops sending pushes to this token for your account (call it when signing out). Idempotent; another account's token is left alone.

get.description: Your notification preferences, one per kind of push. Every one is on by default.

patch.description: Send any subset of the notification preferences; the ones left out do not change. Unknown keys or non-boolean values are a 400. Returns the full settings.

get.description: Public (no token) so it can be used directly as an image URL. Only the user's current avatar is served; file names are random, so older or guessed ones return 404.

get.summary: Check if a username is available
get.description: Normalizes the username (optional @, lowercase) and says whether nobody else has it. Your own current username counts as available. 400 if it breaks the format rules. For checking while typing.

post.description: Asks to become friends with someone whose profile you can open. They are friends only once the receiver accepts. If they already sent you one, you become friends at once (`friends`). Sending again while it is pending, or to a friend, is not an error. A request the receiver rejected is silent: you still get `sent`, nothing reaches them until 30 days after the rejection. Notifies the receiver (`friendRequest`). 400 to yourself, 404 if the user does not exist or there is a block in either direction, 429 past 30 sent requests in 24 hours.

429.description: Daily limit or rate limit reached

delete.summary: Cancel a friend request you sent

get.description: Name, username, avatar, bio and friend counts are always visible. Featured photos and the full friend list only if canSee: it is you, a friend, or the profile is public. Never includes the email. 404 if the user does not exist.

If you can see the profile (it is you, a friend, or the profile is public) every friend (scope all); otherwise only the friends you have in common (scope mutual). Sorted by name. Only id, name, username and avatar. 404 if the user does not exist.

post.description: Returns an 8-character code (the link is rollo://friends/<code>) valid for 1 hour and reusable while it lives. Generating a new one invalidates the previous links of the user.

post.summary: Become friends with whoever made a link
post.description: Send exactly one of `code` (a link that is still valid) or `claimToken` (from /friend-links/claim, valid 24 hours, single use). The friendship is symmetric and needs no acceptance. Redeeming your own link or one from a current friend is not an error. A wrong, expired or replaced code always gets the same 400. 10 failed attempts per user or per IP in an hour lock it (429).

429.description: Daily limit or rate limit reached

get.description: The friend and the rollos both of you are active members of (neither left nor was removed), most recent start first. 404 if you are not friends, also for an unknown id or your own.

delete.description: Removes the friendship in both directions. Also 204 if you were not friends. Rollos you share are not affected.

put.description: Idempotent and one-directional. Also removes the friendship in both directions. Does not remove anyone from a rollo. Also removes the blocked user's photos from your featured list. A new block is emailed to support (at most 3 reports and blocks per user per 24 hours, and 20 per day overall, are emailed). More than 50 blocks per user per 24 hours is a 429.

429.description: Daily limit or rate limit reached

delete.description: Only removes your own block; a block the other user made on you stays. Also 204 if you had not blocked them. Friendship is not restored.

post.summary: Report a photo, a comment or a person
post.description: Send exactly one of `mediaId`, `commentId` or `userId`. Idempotent: reporting the same photo, comment or person again is a 204 and does not email support again. A reported photo disappears from the reporter's own views (and from their featured photos); a reported comment, from their comment lists and counts. At most 3 reports and blocks per user per 24 hours (and 20 per day overall) are emailed to support; the rest are stored without email. More than 50 reports per user per 24 hours is a 429. 404 if the photo or comment is not one the reporter can see (a comment: only active members of its rollo); 400 if it is theirs.

429.description: Daily limit or rate limit reached

post.summary: Open a friend link (no session needed)
post.description: For someone who opens the link before having an account. Returns who invited them and a claim token (valid 24 hours) to redeem the friendship once signed in. A wrong, expired or replaced code always gets the same 400. Rate limited per IP.

429.description: Daily limit or rate limit reached

post.description: Whoever creates it becomes the admin. The profile must have a name and a username. Returns the invite code.

With the invite code. The profile must have a name and a username. Idempotent: 201 when newly joined (or back after leaving), 200 when already an active member. Someone removed by the admin gets 403. Revealed rollos 409.

get.description: Trip, members and how many photos and videos you have left today.

post.summary: Add your friends to the trip
post.description: Any member adds their own friends directly. The answer is per friend (never all-or-nothing): `added` (also when they had left and come back), `already_member`, or `unavailable` (not your friend, removed by the admin, or unknown). The rollo's admin can add back someone who was removed (they become active again with their old photos); for a regular member a removed person stays `unavailable`. A revealed rollo gets 409 for the whole request.

429.description: Daily limit or rate limit reached

patch.description: `allowFeaturing`: whether others may feature your photos of this rollo on their profile (on by default). Turning it off removes them from other profiles; turning it on restores nothing.

delete.description: You lose access and the rollo leaves your list; your photos stay in the roll. You can come back with the code or if a friend adds you (before the reveal). The admin can't leave (409).
They lose access to the rollo and cannot rejoin by code or through a regular member; only the admin can add them back as a friend. Their photos stay in the roll.

post.description: Returns signed URLs to upload the original and the thumbnail straight to R2; each is signed for the exact byte size declared (`sizeBytes`, `thumbSizeBytes`). Idempotent by `id`: retrying from the offline queue neither duplicates nor spends quota. 503 when the storage limit is reached (new registrations only, never retries).

200.description: Retry: new URLs, or it was already uploaded

429.description: Daily limit or rate limit reached

503.description: Storage limit reached; new uploads are paused

post.description: Checks that the original and the thumbnail are in R2 and that their sizes match what was registered. Only then does the photo show up in the feed. On a size mismatch both files are deleted and the media stays pending (register again for new URLs).

429.description: Daily limit or rate limit reached

get.description: Before the reveal: metadata only (author, time, place, caption, thumbhash), no files, not even your own. After: includes dimensions, the download paths, whether you featured each photo, whether its author blocked featuring, and its likes (`likeCount`, `likedByMe`) and comments (`commentCount`). Every item carries the author's user id (`author.userId`). Photos you reported and photos by people you blocked are left out.

200.description: Feed ordered by the time the shot was taken

get.summary: Download a file (only after the reveal)
get.description: Streamed from R2 with the same Bearer token.

429.description: Daily limit or rate limit reached

delete.summary: Delete a photo or video from the trip (admin, before the reveal)
delete.description: Once sent, a photo can be neither deleted nor retaken. The exception is the admin, in case someone sends something inappropriate: they can delete any photo of the trip before the reveal. The files are deleted but the quota is **not given back** to anyone, and the id cannot be registered again.

put.summary: Don't let others feature this photo (author only)
put.description: Removes it from everyone else's profile and stops new ones (they get 409). You can still feature it yourself. Idempotent. Works even if you left the rollo or were removed from it. 403 if you did not take it; 404 if it does not exist or you neither took it nor are an active member of its rollo.

delete.summary: Let others feature this photo again (author only)
delete.description: Idempotent. Works even if you left the rollo or were removed from it. Photos removed from other profiles while it was blocked do not come back.

put.summary: Feature a photo on your profile
put.description: A photo (not a video) of a revealed rollo you are an active member of, yours or someone else's. Idempotent. 404 if it does not exist or you are not an active member; 409 if the rollo is not revealed, if its author does not let others feature it (unless you took it) or if you already have 60; 400 for a video.

delete.summary: Remove a photo from your profile
delete.description: 204 also if it was not featured.

get.description: Newest photo first (by when it was taken). Only if you can see the profile (it is you, a friend, or it is public); otherwise 403. Each photo carries a ~5 km zone instead of its location, its author when it is not the owner, and its likes; never the rollo or the caption. Photos you reported or by authors you blocked, and photos that were deleted, blocked by their author, or whose rollo the owner left do not show up.

Streamed from R2 under the profile's permission (not the rollo's): 403 if you can't see the profile, 404 if that user does not feature this photo (or it no longer shows on their profile). Same caching as the trip download.

429.description: Daily limit or rate limit reached

put.description: Idempotent. Whoever can see the photo can like it: an active member of its rollo once it is revealed, or anyone who can see a profile where it is featured. Otherwise 404 (also with a block with its author); 400 for a video. Notifies the author (`photoLiked`) at most once every 30 minutes per photo: the likes in between are counted and added to the next push ("A Cami y 3 más les gustó tu foto").

429.description: Daily limit or rate limit reached

delete.summary: Remove your like from a photo
delete.description: Idempotent: 204 also if you did not like it (or the photo does not exist). Never notifies.

get.description: Only yours. The photos you liked and can open today, most recent like first, paginated with `cursor`. Filtered by the server: a photo drops out if its rollo is not revealed or you left it and no profile you can see still features it, the profile became private, you are not friends anymore, the photo was un-featured, there is a block with its author or you reported it (the like is kept and the photo comes back if you regain access). `source` says where to open it: the rollo wins over a profile.

get.summary: List the comments of a photo
get.description: Oldest first. Only active members of the photo's rollo, once it is revealed: otherwise 404 (also with a block with the photo's author). Leaves out deleted comments, comments of users blocked in either direction and the ones you reported. A video has none (empty list).

post.description: Plain text, up to 500 characters. Same permissions as listing; 400 for a video. Notifies the photo's author and whoever commented before (`photoCommented`), at most once every 30 minutes per photo: the comments in between are counted and added to the next push.

429.description: Daily limit or rate limit reached

delete.description: The author of the comment or the author of its photo. Another member of the rollo gets 403. 404 if the comment does not exist, is already deleted, or you can't see its photo.
